findings.title: Host lookup is not case-insensitive
findings.body: `record_for_host` runs `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` but never downcases the `host` argument. `URI#host` keeps the original case, so a referer or URL with uppercase letters (e.g. Eviltrout.com) is rejected even though the stored host matches. The fix is to compare against `host.downcase`.

findings.title: before_validation crashes on nil host
findings.body: The callback calls `self.host.sub!` without checking for nil. Saving a record whose host is nil raises NoMethodError, so the admin API returns a 500 instead of a validation error. The `sub!` calls also mutate the attribute string in place, which can bypass ActiveRecord dirty tracking.

findings.title: Host format regex rejects ports, localhost and long TLDs
findings.body: The pattern requires a dot and a TLD of 2–5 letters, so hosts like `localhost`, IP addresses and newer long TLDs (e.g. `.community`) cannot be saved. Separately, `record_for_host` compares only `uri.host`, so a stored host with a port (which the regex allows) can never match a referer.

findings.title: Migration crashes when embed_category setting is absent
findings.body: The query uses `execute(...)[0]['id']`. When no `embed_category` site setting exists (the common case), `[0]` returns nil and `['id']` raises NoMethodError, so the migration fails. The same pattern on line 15 fails when `uncategorized_category_id` is not stored in site_settings, which happens whenever it was left at its default.

findings.title: Unescaped interpolation and unnormalized hosts in migration INSERT
findings.body: Host values are interpolated directly into the INSERT SQL, so a quote in the stored setting breaks the migration (SQL injection risk). The values are also inserted raw, without stripping `http://`/`https://` or `\r`. Migrated rows such as `http://example.com` therefore never match `uri.host`, and embedding silently stops working for those sites.

findings.title: Missing record causes 500
findings.body: `update` and `destroy` use `where(...).first` and then call methods on the result without checking for nil. A request for a nonexistent id raises NoMethodError and returns a 500 instead of a 404.

findings.title: embeddable_hosts list not hydrated from embedded ids
findings.body: The serializer sends `embeddable_host_ids`, but `_lookupSubType` resolves them against `root['embeddable_hosts']`. Unless that root key is sideloaded, the lookups return undefined, so `embedding.embeddable_hosts` contains undefined entries. `pushObject` then operates on a plain array of undefined values, which breaks the admin list.

findings.title: replace only swaps first underscore
findings.body: `type.replace('_', '-')` replaces only the first underscore. Any model type with more than one underscore is not normalized and will not match ADMIN_MODELS, so it is routed to the non-admin path.

findings.title: Test name no longer matches behavior
findings.body: The test "is false if embeddable_host is blank" now passes only because `embed_truncate` defaults to false. `expandable_first_post?` no longer checks for embeddable hosts at all, so the test does not verify what its name claims.
